boxes.html:
IPAX Lucid Glass editor

Select, drag, and resize this editable text box anywhere over the picture. Use the inspector on the right to adjust contrast, blur, and feather.

The engine recalculates background lightness in real time to guarantee perfect legibility (WCAG 2 compliant) without the need for flat overlays or dark gradients.

Click outside this box (on the canvas) to change the stage background or access Load, Save & Reset.

The effect can be applied either to the box or to the text itself. In this case, it's applied to the text via the --ipax-text property.

It works like a text-shadow, but instead of casting a solid color, it adjusts pixel luminosity within a feathered region, just enough to keep the glyphs legible.

It can also blur only those pixels, reducing the detail that competes with text glyphs.
